headline: Euro Zone Inflation Hits Three-Year High, Boosting Rate Hike Odds
summary: Euro zone inflation reached a three-year high last month, driven by food and energy costs, strengthening the case for a European Central Bank rate hike in December.
why: Inflation prints directly influence European Central Bank monetary policy decisions, which set benchmark borrowing costs across the euro zone.

impacts.name: Euro zone inflation rate
impacts.why: Higher consumer prices directly increase the headline inflation metric.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher consumer price inflation directly fuels expectations of monetary tightening by the European Central Bank.
